title: A gate whose question names a constant such as DISPATCH_BASE_TOKENS is classed secrets by the word token inside the identifier
goal: class_reasons does not read the word token inside an upper-case identifier (DISPATCH_BASE_TOKENS, MAX_TOKENS) as a secret, so a gate about a token-count constant gets the class its touches and other words give

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_authority as a; sys.exit(0 if a.class_reasons({'touches':['_tools/census.py']},{'id':'g9','question':'What is census.DISPATCH_BASE_TOKENS?','options':[]})[0]=='design' else 1)
